bound.walk: copy printed untemplated GET paths from the official MET Sigcharts swagger; skip templated {format} paths and GET operations that print required query parameters; skip the root path because it has no last-segment id; native ids are the last printed path segment; access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path; do not invent dataset ids or area/offset/time filters
bound.how: pda ingest --source sigcharts --limit 10. The official MET Sigcharts swagger prints 6 untemplated GET paths that have a last-segment id and no required query parameter. The adapter copies those paths. GET uses the printed /locations collection with no invented query filters. The root product path has no last-segment id so it stays unused for listing and fetch. /available prints XML so it stays unused for fetch.
